verses.1: And on the third day of marriage, it took place in Cana in Galilee. The mother of Jesus was also there.
verses.2: Also, Jesus and his disciples were chosen for marriage.
verses.3: And after the wine was poured out, the mother of Jesus said to him, “They have no wine.”
verses.4: And Jesus said to her, “What is it that you want from me, woman? Now will come the time of my judgment.”
verses.5: His mother says to the vendors, “What would you like me to say to you?”
verses.6: There were also six stones there, arranged according to the purification rituals of the Jews. They were divided into groups of two or three stones each.
verses.7: Jesus said to them, “Fill your containers with water.” And they filled them up, to the top.
verses.8: And he said to them, “Now, take it and give it to the archbishop. But those who were kneeled down refused to do so.”
verses.9: When the archtrichilus tasted the water that had been turned into wine, and he didn’t know where it came from, the ministers knew who had brought the water. The archtrichilus then spoke to the nymph.
verses.10: And he said to him, “Every person first puts the good wine into their mouth. And when they drink it, they find it too strong. You, however, have tasted the good wine right from the start.”
verses.11: It was in this manner that Jesus began the practice of using signs and symbols in Galilee. He thereby enhanced his own glory. His disciples also believed in him because of this.
verses.12: After that, he went down to Kafarnaum himself, along with his mother, his brothers, and his disciples. They stayed there for several days.
verses.13: And it was a time of suffering for the Jews. Then Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
verses.14: And in the temple, they found those who were selling cattle, sheep, and goats. There were also those who were processing wool.
verses.15: And after he had made a covering from ropes, he removed all the livestock and animals from the temple. He also took away the coins and tables from the stalls.
verses.16: And to those who sell sheep, he said, “Do this from afar. Do not turn my father’s house into a place for trading.”
verses.17: The disciples remembered that it was written: “The greed of your house will destroy me.”
verses.18: So the Jews replied to him, “What sign do you show us that you can do these things?”
verses.19: Jesus replied to them, “Lay down the boat here, and I will raise it again in three days.”
verses.20: So said the Jews: This altar was built after forty-six years. And you, in three days, will be able to sanctify it.
verses.21: And he spoke about the body of Christ in that temple.
verses.22: When he rose from the dead, his disciples remembered that he had said these things. They believed in what Jesus said, both through his words and his actions.
verses.23: And those who were in the Holy City during that day of fasting, many believed in His name, seeing the signs He had done.
verses.24: But Jesus did not believe that he could do all these things on his own.
verses.25: And since it wasn’t necessary for anyone else to testify about that person, he himself would determine what was truly true about that person.
